name: find_kit_connector
description: Kit-bash analysis: find a kit part's joining peg and the joint AXIS it threads along, robustly, without guessing from ambiguous box faces or gear teeth. Method: decompose the mesh into loose islands; detect the cog 'tooth ring' (a group of >=4 near-identical small square posts) which DEFINES the joint axis and center; then return the lone elongated square island that is COAXIAL with that ring (axis parallel, centered on the ring's axis) as the connector peg. Returns {connector:{center,axis,length,cross_section,squareness,verts}, joint_axis, joint_center, teeth_count}. Falls back to a connector-likeness ranking when no clear tooth ring exists. Read-only. Pair with stack_parts: stack [partA, peg, partB] along joint_axis with a negative gap so the peg inserts through both center holes (exposed = peg_length - 2*insert). See the kitbash-axis-stacking skill.

min_verts.description: Ignore islands smaller than this. Default 8.

coax_dist.description: Max perpendicular distance from the ring axis for an island to count as coaxial. Default 6.
